title: Loan Approval Prediction
description: Developed a machine learning model to predict loan approval outcomes using applicant data.
details: Developed a machine learning-based loan approval prediction system to automate credit risk assessment
Performed data cleaning, preprocessing, and feature engineering to prepare applicant financial data for modeling
Conducted exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify key factors influencing loan approval decisions
Implemented classification algorithms including Logistic Regression and Decision Tree to predict loan eligibility
Evaluated model performance using accuracy metrics to ensure reliable and consistent predictions
Built and deployed an interactive Streamlit application to provide a user-friendly interface for non-technical users to test loan predictions without requiring coding or backend access
Designed a scalable workflow demonstrating the practical application of predictive analytics in financial decision-making

title: Sales Performance Analytics Dashboard
description: Built an interactive Excel dashboard that transforms raw sales data into actionable insights.
details: Developed an interactive dashboard to analyze and visualize sales data across multiple dimensions (time, region, product)
Utilized Pivot Tables, slicers, and dynamic charts to enable real-time filtering and exploration of KPIs
Performed data cleaning and transformation to ensure accuracy and consistency of insights
Identified key revenue drivers, top-performing products, and underperforming regions
Designed a user-friendly interface to support data-driven decision-making for business stakeholders

title: Human Resources Analytics
description: Built an interactive Excel dashboard that transforms raw sales data into actionable insights.
details: Developed an interactive HR analytics dashboard in Microsoft Excel to analyze employee data across multiple dimensions
Utilized Pivot Tables, slicers, and dynamic charts to enable real-time filtering and exploration of key HR metrics
Performed data cleaning and transformation to ensure accuracy and consistency of employee records
Conducted exploratory data analysis to identify trends in employee attrition, demographics, and departmental distribution
Visualized key insights such as workforce composition, salary structure, and performance indicators
Identified patterns influencing employee retention and provided data-driven insights to support HR decision-making
Designed a user-friendly and professional dashboard interface for effective stakeholder interaction and reporting
